$comment: PRODUCT-OWNER ACCEPTANCES OF PRODUCTION DEPENDENCY RISK.
This file is the ONLY place a production vulnerability may be called 'accepted'. It records a decision
the Product Owner actually made, not an assessment the delivery agent made about itself. A finding that
has been investigated and understood but not accepted is TRIAGED, which is a different word and a
different outcome: the gate fails on it.
An acceptance names the exact advisories it covers. A package-level acceptance would silently absorb
the next, unrelated advisory published against the same package -- which is how a real risk becomes
Every entry requires: package, advisories (GHSA ids), severity, rationale, decided_by, decision_ref (the
governance transition that carries the decision), decided_on and expires_on. An expired acceptance is
treated as no acceptance at all.
The list is EMPTY, and that is a measured state rather than an omission: as of 2026-08-13 the production
dependency tree of hotel-admin reports zero advisories (npm audit --omit=dev), so there is nothing to
accept. See docs/PHASE4_DEPENDENCY_TRIAGE.md for how it got there.
